title: P1: Add follow-up edit-by-prompt flow for generated stories
description: Implement a first-class edit workflow so users can revise an already generated story by entering a follow-up instruction. Scope should include API support, web UI affordance, and provenance/event logging that links edited runs to the original run/artifact.
acceptance_criteria: Web UI exposes an Edit/Revise action after successful generation; user can enter a follow-up edit prompt against an existing run; API supports edit requests linked to a parent run; edited run returns a new artifact while preserving relationship to prior run in metadata/events; CLI supports equivalent edit command or documented fallback flow.

title: P2: Add global run-ledger JSONL for Story Writer runs
description: Add an append-only JSONL run ledger to capture each run lifecycle for analytics/debugging (request metadata, status transitions, durations, retrieval stats, and artifact quality signals) in addition to per-run state/event files.
acceptance_criteria: System writes to a global JSONL ledger file under story-writer cache/storage; each run records at least created + terminal entries with run_id, timestamps, status, prompt metadata (safe subset), and key retrieval counters; writes are thread-safe and do not break existing per-run files; docs mention ledger path/fields and intended use; tests cover ledger creation and terminal entry writing.

title: P1: Design and implement full agentic loop runtime
description: Move beyond retrieval-only hybrid orchestration to a fuller agentic loop capable of tool use, recovery, and reattempts across retrieval/drafting/repair boundaries with explicit safety limits and observability.
acceptance_criteria: Repo includes a technical design doc for full agentic loop phases and safeguards; implementation supports multi-step tool decisions with bounded retries/recovery after tool failures or zero-result calls; run events expose each decision/retry path clearly; regression tests cover failure recovery and reattempt behavior for Apple Music query misses; migration plan documents coexistence or replacement path for current hybrid runtime.

comments.author: Illya Bomash
comments.text:
Next-session implementation prompt:

Read Beads issue apple-js7 and implement a full agentic Story Writer runtime that can plan, call tools, recover, and reattempt across retrieval, drafting, and repair in one bounded loop. Keep V0 API compatibility unless explicitly changing contract.

Goals:
- Replace or gate the current hybrid split between retrieval loop and separate draft/repair calls.
- Add explicit phase/state tracking so runs show clear agent decisions and retries.
- Improve Apple Music relevance and retry behavior with tool-aware query shaping and quality checks before finalize.

Required design work:
- Write a technical design doc in apps/story_writer describing architecture, states, limits, guardrails, and migration from current hybrid implementation.
- Define stop conditions, max step budget, per-tool retry policy, and failure classification.
- Define event schema additions for observability, including decision id, action, attempt number, fallback reason, and confidence or quality metrics.

Implementation scope:
- Introduce an agent runtime that supports actions: search_apple_music, search_wikipedia, draft_story, validate_story, repair_story, finalize, fail.
- Keep strict safety limits: max steps, max consecutive failures, max retries per action type.
- Preserve cancellation behavior and existing run status transitions.
- Ensure finalize only when validation passes and minimum evidence quality checks are met.

Quality and tests:
- Add or update tests for: tool failure recovery, zero-result retries, malformed model decision recovery, validation-repair loop, and terminal failure when limits exceeded.
- Keep current tests passing or update them intentionally with rationale.
- Run ruff and pytest for apps/story_writer.

Deliverables:
- Code changes with clear comments only where needed for non-obvious control flow.
- Updated docs for runtime protocol and user guide sections that changed.
- A short migration note explaining hybrid compatibility and next deprecation steps.

Acceptance checklist:
- Agent can reattempt after empty or failed tool calls with bounded retries.
- Run event log clearly explains each decision and recovery path.
- Final artifact quality is measurably improved for prompts like trip-hop beyond Portishead.
- Tests and lint pass.

title: P1: Improve Artifact panel rendering and export UX
description: Artifact panel currently renders raw JSON only. Replace with user-friendly presentation: render core Markdown/MDX body as rich text, add a download button for the MDX package artifact, and move remaining structured JSON fields into an expandable details section.
acceptance_criteria: Artifact view renders story Markdown content as formatted rich text; user can download generated MDX package via explicit button; non-primary JSON fields remain accessible in collapsible/expandable details section; behavior works on desktop and mobile layouts.
notes: Implemented artifact UX in Story Writer web client: rich-text rendering of story MDX body/sections, markdown heading/list support in artifact renderer, download button for a zip package, and expandable artifact details for validation/provenance fields. Added API endpoint GET /v0/runs/{run_id}/artifact/package and API contract test coverage for package contents. Verified with ruff check and pytest.

title: iOS: Investigate missing Last.fm scrobble log entries
description: User reports successful Last.fm sign-in; scrobbles may be working but in-app scrobble log stays empty. Verify log append path, candidate finalization, and scrobble status logging; add diagnostics if needed.
notes: Findings: diagnostics show skipped scrobbles only; candidate finalizes on track change/stop; preview intent default helped explain skips. Next: validate scrobble after full intent and confirm candidate finalization/queueing.

title: Update scrobble completion guard + tests
description:
Backlog: backlog/tasks/task-133 - iOS-Add-Last.fm-scrobbling-support.md

Goal:
- Replace the 90% threshold with a near-end guard (within 30s) and update tests.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Completion guard rules implemented:
  - duration >= 60s: `playbackTime >= duration - 30s`.
  - duration < 60s: `playbackTime >= duration * 0.8`.
  - duration missing: `playbackTime >= 30s`.
- [ ] Scrobble decision occurs at track end or stop using the latest playbackTime snapshot.
- [ ] Unit tests updated/added for the new rules.

Notes:
- See `LastFMScrobblePolicy` and scrobble candidate finalization logic.
notes: done: updated LastFMScrobblePolicy near-end guard + tests

title: Design playback event architecture for scrobbling
description:
Backlog: backlog/tasks/task-133 - iOS-Add-Last.fm-scrobbling-support.md

Goal:
- Produce a playback-event architecture write-up that ensures scrobbling gets reliable start/progress/end signals.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Document available MusicKit event sources (player state, queue changes, playbackTime sampling).
- [ ] Define event semantics: track start, progress updates, track end, interruptions/backgrounding.
- [ ] Cover both ApplicationMusicPlayer and SystemMusicPlayer behaviors.
- [ ] Recommend a concrete implementation (e.g., observers + periodic tick) and diagnostics to verify correctness.
- [ ] Publish the write-up in `ios/architecture.md` or a new doc and link it from there.

Notes:
- Current code only observes `state.objectWillChange` and `queue.objectWillChange`, so playbackTime does not advance continuously.
- Scrobble candidate finalizes on track change or playback stopped; missing progress updates can prevent meeting the threshold.
- Include guidance on logging/telemetry to debug missing events.
notes:
Completed playback event architecture write-up in ios/architecture.md.
Spec update: scrobble completion guard is within 30s of end for tracks >= 60s; short tracks use 80% threshold; missing duration requires >= 30s playbackTime.

title: Ensure story plays use full intent
description:

Notes:

title: Implement playback event sampling for scrobbling
description:
Backlog: backlog/tasks/task-133 - iOS-Add-Last.fm-scrobbling-support.md

Goal:
- Emit reliable playback snapshots using MusicKit observers plus periodic sampling while playing.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Playback snapshots emit on player state changes and queue changes.
- [ ] While playing, a periodic tick samples `playbackTime` every 1-5s and emits snapshots.
- [ ] Tick stops when not playing and resumes on play.
- [ ] Active player switches (Application vs System) rebind observers correctly.
- [ ] App lifecycle transitions capture a final snapshot and resume sampling on foreground.

Notes:
- This can live in `AppleMusicPlaybackController` or a small coordinator.
- Include a `reason` in snapshots (state-change, queue-change, tick, lifecycle) for diagnostics.
notes: done: playback snapshot sampling tick, lifecycle snapshots, and reason/active player support wired to scrobble pipeline

title: Adjust scrobbling rules for 2-minute threshold
description:
Backlog: none

Goal:
- Scrobble tracks once playback reaches 2 minutes, while keeping near-end scrobbles for shorter tracks.

Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Scrobble eligibility triggers at 120 seconds of playback.
- [ ] Tracks shorter than 2 minutes still scrobble near the end (existing completion logic preserved).
- [ ] Diagnostic logs indicate which threshold triggered the scrobble decision.

Notes:
- Coordinate with LastFMScrobblePolicy and candidate finalization behavior.
notes: Implemented 120s minimum-playback scrobble threshold for tracks >=120s, preserved near-end eligibility for shorter tracks via max(duration*completionFraction, duration-completionGraceSeconds), and added diagnostics metadata (threshold_seconds + threshold_reason). Added/updated policy tests and ran ./scripts/ios.sh swift-test.
close_reason: Completed: policy + diagnostics updated and Swift tests passing
